systems.country_label: SIGE (Sistema Integrado de Gestão Escolar), called Guinea-Bissau's EMIS
systems.platform: Developed with the support of the UNESCO Institute for Statistics, established in 2015 with donor financing
systems.owner: Ministry of National Education (MEN), with European Union support at regional level and World Bank and GPE financing for data systems
systems.tiers: One region only, with 207 schools; rollout to other regions planned for 2022; collection relies on paper-based questionnaires and the data entry of them
In use since 2011, with minimal statistical data generated (less than 45 MB)

systems.owner: A prize-winning proposal in a digital solutions competition
systems.tiers: Schools: to create online teaching modules and manage school personnel and assets; described as a proposed solution, not as in use

note: No fact: SIGE is described as the collection of school-level administrative data by questionnaire, not systematically capturing data and with no national figures since 2014-2015; no entry by schools of per-learner records is described. Passages only.
